## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation lifts market internals; Confirmation 2: major-cap divergences (multiple megacaps showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) argue for caution rather than a clean risk-on; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +21.26%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND; Technology showing strength on momentum names: META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: sector 1W -0.18% with TMUS/others under pressure; Healthcare showing internal stress despite winners: UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND and CVS (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; Financials muted with large-cap weakness: JPM (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -10.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt given tech heavy names among leaders but cyclical participation is meaningful.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PSA (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +5.96%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -4.76% | 1M: -5.98%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +7.84%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -12.55%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select financials, staples and enterprise software.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND. Watch major-cap divergences: AAPL (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -5.68%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +5.73% | 1M: -1.52%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — tactical volatility potential.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive on momentum names: META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -5.68%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +3.12% (19 stocks) — internal rotation across large caps and select winners.

8. Financials Outlook?
Muting signs of stress in large-cap payments and banks: JPM (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -12.55%) BELOW TREND, while pockets of support exist. Sector 1W: +0.65% (20 stocks) — breadth shallow relative to other leading sectors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Highly bifurcated: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +8.02%) ABOVE TREND versus UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND and ABT (1W: -10.62% | 1M: -12.81%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +0.02% (15 stocks) — defensive names mixed with event-driven winners and policy-driven losers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to the momentum leaders (META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to structurally weak large-caps showing confirmed downside (UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -12.55%) BELOW TREND). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but manage position sizing given major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND on Phase 3 readout; META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND on ad/macro rebound; NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY on China import news. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND on policy risk; CVS (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (NEM ABOVE TREND) and Energy (SLB ABOVE TREND) given commodity strength and earnings cadence; Technology for continued momentum in select names. BEARISH: Communication for ongoing weakness and Healthcare policy risk centered on payers/providers.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — watch sustained weekly momentum and follow-through on China import catalyst. META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND — confirm with next weekly close above recent breakout. UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND — monitor further downside if policy headlines persist. ORCL (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -11.20%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure to reclaim monthly trend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GILD (+80): Trodelvy combo Phase 3 win; price confirming momentum — GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND. NVDA (+75): China import of H200 chips; NVDA (1W: +5.87% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — news supports 1W strength but 1M divergence remains. CRM (+65): large contract win; CRM (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) — monitor for follow-through (CRM included in sentiment list; cross-check price action before positioning).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-60): policy proposals hit payers; UNH (1W: -16.47% | 1M: -13.70%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. CVS (-60): same policy pressure; CVS (1W: -9.36% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND — news and price aligned. AMT (-55): valuation pressure from downgrades; AMT (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) — follow for distribution signals (AMT in news list; confirm SP100 price action).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Growth/Momentum tilt given leadership concentration in tech and select cyclicals. GILD (1W: +13.56% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +33.42%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA RECOVERY vs UNH/CVS/ORCL BELOW TREND) and mixed news sentiment warrant selective positioning and close monitoring.
